key_rules: NO XAI pattern (tradingai.ai) unless AI is intrinsic to the term
NO brand/trademark domains (UDRP risk = negative EV)
Supabase is the ONLY source of truth — Google Sheet only on explicit Tim request
All .ai = 2-year minimum registration = EUR 157.99 per domain
Do NOT purchase domains — only check availability and add to Supabase pending
Tim resale values override agent estimates when provided
Afternic + Atom.com are the only listing platforms. Sedo permanently skipped.
Lease-to-Own ON for all Afternic listings
Min offer = 50% of Buy Now. Never counter below 85% of ask.
